title: Example 13-6: Word with Unspaced Internal Foot

illustrates.quote: The foot and caesura symbols may begin or end a braille line when it is necessary to divide a line between braille lines. Exception: Do not break a line at a meter symbol when it is unspaced within a word.

blocks.features: One line shown twice: first as ordinary text with foot marks (vertical pipes) between words, then repeated with a foot mark placed UNSPACED inside a single word ('u|pon') to show a foot division occurring within a word.

lines.text: All the | night sleep | came not u|pon my | eyelids

print.notes: Picture on PDF p.363; the pipe between 'u' and 'pon' is printed with no surrounding space, unlike the other (spaced) pipes in the same line.
